g.text: Question list fixed and ground truth read from the cells (no model)
pi asks each question with only the Excel MCP tools
Each answer checked for value, cited cell and a read_range call
cmd: just demo-isp-qa | pass: prints 'ground truth read directly from the cells (no model): ...' before any question is asked
cmd: just demo-isp-qa | pass: each row shows value, cell and called as True or False
cmd: just demo-isp-qa | pass: prints 'summary: N/M questions answered correctly with the cell cited and the tool called'
cmd: just demo-isp-qa | pass: prints 'PASS demo-isp-qa' (every question) or exits non-zero with the failing rows
